sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Tongue coated. Agonizing feeling in
chest and stomach, starting from pylorus with flatus
that rolls in balls from one side to the other, loss of
appetite, phlegmy retchings and loss of flesh. (R. T.
Cooper.) Pains increased when food passes pyloric
outlet. Vomiting of coff ce~groundAooking matter. Dis-
tention of stomach. Frequent belching of offensive
flatus. Painful sinking across epigastrium.
